item.title: Roger Waters Says He Never Liked Ozzy Osbourne Or Black Sabbath: 'I Couldn't Give A @#$%!'
item.description: Roger Waters, the former Pink Floyd leader, said he never cared for Ozzy Osbourne or Black Sabbath, and he delivered it with his typical nuclear frankness. Subtle? Not his brand.

item.title: JAMES LABRIE Reveals What It’s Really Like Having MIKE PORTNOY Back In DREAM THEATER
item.description: DREAM THEATER singer James LaBrie recently shared his thoughts on the band’s monumental reunion with founding drummer Mike Portnoy, stating that after a few initial shows, the feeling of having him back was no longer “surreal” but simply “right.

item.title: BRUCE DICKINSON Talks About Why IRON MAIDEN’s Sound Stops Him From Using 'Bone-Crushing Heaviness'
item.description: In a recent interview with Shaggy of the 94.9 and 104.5 The Pick radio station, IRON MAIDEN frontman Bruce Dickinson opened up about the deliberate “heavier” musical direction of his solo work compared to the band’s output.

item.title: The One Drummer PHIL COLLINS Admired But Called Out For Having A Massive Ego: 'The Size of a Hotel'
item.description: Phil Collins wasn’t just the voice that brought pop stardom to Genesis. He also helped redefine how drums were recorded in the 1980s, built a massive solo career, and even teamed up with unexpected names, like when he played with Led Zeppelin.

item.title: The RUSH Album That Led to Fan Backlash, Internal Tension, and a Moment of Regret: 'It Wasn’t the Smartest Move'
item.description: Most bands with long careers eventually take a creative detour. Whether to keep things fresh or avoid burnout, they try something new. Sometimes it works. Sometimes it doesn’t.

item.title: Jethro Tull’s Ian Anderson Slams Brazilian Fans & iPhones: "Crowds Are Worse Than Ever"
item.description: So Ian Anderson, flute-wielding sorcerer of JETHRO TULL, has had it with you people—yes, YOU, the one recording an entire concert through a cracked iPhone 8 with 2% battery while also screaming “PLAY THICK AS A BRICK!

item.title: Watch: DREAM THEATER Releases 'Night Terror' Video Ahead of 'Parasomnia' Album
item.description: February 7, 2025, marks the arrival of DREAM THEATER’s sixteenth album, “Parasomnia,” via InsideOut Music. This time, they’ve reunited with their prodigal son, drummer Mike Portnoy, whose last contribution to the band dates back to 2009’s “Black Clouds & Silver Linings.
